description: This file defines helper functions and data structures for managing context in a cellular management system using RBUS. It includes functions for initializing and releasing context, converting paths, setting and getting row contexts, and managing dynamic table synchronization. The header also provides data structures and macros for handling property contexts.

methods.name: Context_Init
methods.description: Initializes the context helper API, maintaining a reference count for safe multiple calls.

methods.name: Context_Release
methods.description: Releases the context helper resources, should be called once for each Context_Init.

methods.name: ConvertPath
methods.description: Converts a row alias path to a path containing only instance numbers.

methods.name: GetParentContext
methods.description: Gets the context of the parent row for a parameter inside a row.

methods.name: GetRowContext
methods.description: Gets the context for a specific row identified by a path.

methods.name: SetRowContext
methods.description: Sets the context for a newly created row, including its instance number and alias.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByInstNum
methods.description: Removes the context of a row identified by its table name and instance number.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByName
methods.description: Removes the context of a row by its full name (including alias).

methods.name: IsTimeToSyncDynamicTable
methods.description: Determines if it's appropriate to synchronize dynamic tables, preventing multiple sync during partial updates.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Extracts the leaf parameter name from a full path.

methods.name: GetHandlerContext
methods.description: Retrieves the handler context for a specified element name.
